name: vep_cache
description: The Ensembl VEP indexed cache for this genome's species and assembly, at the Ensembl release of this genome's annotation, which is also the tag. Unpacked: `refgenie seek <genome>/vep_cache` is the directory to give VEP as --dir_cache, alongside --offline --cache_version <tag>. Registered only after the cache's own sequence directories were compared with this genome's sequence names and lengths (bin/prepare_resource.py), which is recorded in the asset's provenance file together with the cache's own info.txt. A cache is tied to its release: use it with the VEP of the same number.

required_files.description: the fetch record and compatibility summary

required_assets.description: the genome the cache's coordinates are in
